mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_account_audit (user_id, audit_status, apply_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{auditStatus}, #{applyTime})
mapper.select: SELECT reject_reason FROM sys_account_audit WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND audit_status = 'REJECTED' ORDER BY audit_time DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM sys_account_audit a JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = a.user_id AND u.is_deleted = 0 WHERE 1 = 1 AND a.audit_status = #{status} AND u.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%') AND u.job_no = #{jobNo}
